item.title: Constantine Movie Reportedly in the Works at DC Studios
item.description: Francis Galluppi, writer and director of Evil Dead Wrath , has reportedly been brought on board to write a Constantine movie for DC Studios . It is currently unknown whether this film is a sequel to Constantine (2005) or a completely new adaptation of the comic, but the latter seems to be the likely case.

item.title: Everything Is Dissapointing After Pokémon's Spectacular 30th Anniversary TCG Set
item.description: There's nothing wrong with the set. In any other scenario, Delta Reign would be a highlight of a busy TCG release year. Unfortunately, Pokémon's new TCG set is dropping after one of The Pokémon Company's best — if not the best — set releases ever.

item.title: WoW: Forever Had a Very Smooth Launch — Except for Horde PvP Players
item.description: After a rough start for the World of Warcraft: Forever beta due to very high demand , many players expected to see long queues, disconnects, and worse when the game launched in full on Wednesday. But no such problems materialized in what must be one of Blizzard's smoothest game launches yet.

item.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s Changes to the Infamous Water Temple Are Actually Brilliant
item.description: With The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time ’s Switch 2 remake out now, long-time Nintendo fans are in for a lot of warm nostalgia. A trek through the lost woods, duets with Sheik, a return to the Bombchu Bowling Alley — all of those wonderful moments return in a faithful remake that feels every bit as magical as the Nintendo 64 classic. But with all those wonderful moments comes a painful reunion with one of the most hated moments in Zelda history. Yes, you will have to return to the dreaded Water Temple.

item.title: Pokémon Pokopia Celebrates Fall with Apple-Themed Event
item.description: Applin and its Dragon/Grass-type evolutions are coming to Pokémon Pokopia this November thanks to the Apples for Applin event. It's time to start apple-picking so you can trade with Applin and build habitats for all of its friends.

item.title: Star Wars Actor Officially Confirms the Hunt for Ben Solo Is Dead — and That's a Good Thing.
item.description: After months of Star Wars fans campaigning with billboards and banners flown over Disney HQ, Kylo Ren/Ben Solo actor Adam Driver has driven the final nail into the coffin for anyone hoping for a revival of The Hunt for Ben Solo .

item.title: Dragon Ball Composer Is Elected Texas Attorney General
item.description: The "blue tsunami" that swept America in the latest midterm elections will be remembered for years to come. Amid all the political turmoil, however, one small detail might go unnoticed: Nathan M. Johnson, who was just elected Attorney General of Texas, used to make music for Dragon Ball .

item.title: 3 Near-Perfect Prime Video Series to Binge This Weekend (November 6 – 8)
item.description: Another fall weekend is soon upon us, which means it's time to settle in, fire up your TV, and find the best series worth binging. The arrival of November and the cozy pre-winter weather makes it the perfect time to watch something new or revisit an old classic. Your first instinct might be Netflix's endless library, or perhaps Crunchyroll for some anime entertainment, but Prime Video's extensive streaming platform also has loads to offer if you know where to look (and you already finished Carrie ).

item.title: 39 Years Later, Calvin And Hobbes' Best Quote On Grief Is Still a Heartbreaking Classic
item.description: Most of the time, Bill Watterson's Calvin and Hobbes was a straightforward comedy, set in equal parts a nondescript American suburb and its protagonist's imagination. While it's got more than its share of memorable lines and genuine wisdom, C&H was rarely out to tug on anyone's heartstrings. There are two exceptions to that rule. One is a full story arc from March 1987, in which Calvin tries to rescue a baby raccoon. The other is a one-shot from late in the comic's run, as one of Watterson's more experimental Sunday strips. Both are quiet meditations on death, as Calvin confronts mortality through encounters with animals.

item.title: 11 Years Later, Patrick Stewart's Near-Perfect Siege Thriller Is Officially Free on Streaming
item.description: The late Patrick Stewart made much of his reputation off playing unique heroes and memorable protagonists. If there's one thing that connects Captain Jean-Luc Picard with the "Fox-verse's" Professor Charles Xavier , it's that both characters could be described as idealists, though they take distinctly different approaches thereof.
